heroHeadline: Russia Fires Oreshnik Hypersonic Missile at Bila Tserkva + 600 Drones on Kyiv in Massive Retaliation — 4 Killed, 80+ Injured; Ukraine Strikes Taman Oil Terminal
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,550 of Russia's full-scale invasion, Russia launched one of the war's largest attacks on Kyiv: 600 Shahed-type drones plus 90 missiles striking every district of the Ukrainian capital, killing at least 4 and injuring 80+. Russia also fired an RS-26 Rubizh 'Oreshnik' hypersonic ballistic missile — the nuclear-capable weapon's third wartime use — at Bila Tserkva, Kyiv Oblast (50 km south of the capital). The mass strike is retaliation for Ukraine's May 22 drone strike on a Russian military facility in Starobilsk (occupied Luhansk). On May 23, Ukraine struck Russia's Tamannaftogaz oil terminal on the Taman Peninsula (Krasnodar Krai), extending its 2026 energy-infrastructure campaign past $9 billion in Russian energy losses. Zelensky rejected German Chancellor Merz's proposal for an 'associate' EU tier, demanding full membership; US senators pressed the Pentagon to release a stalled $400M Ukraine aid package. Russian cumulative military losses reached approximately 1,355,920 since February 24, 2022.
